runbooks.diagnosis: Redis is a netns passenger of postgres (network_mode: "service:postgres") — the infra quartet (pgbouncer/redis/memcached) shares postgres's network namespace. Recreating only the owner (postgres recreate/DB bounce) leaves redis orphaned in the dead loopback-only netns, so every consumer of redis:6379 gets connection refused — seen live as an SSE event stream silently losing its route to redis.
remediation: docker compose up -d pgbouncer redis memcached (recreate the passengers so they re-attach to the current postgres netns)
Verify: docker exec opensme-redis redis-cli -a "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --no-auth-warning ping → PONG
Re-test the affected consumer (event stream / cache / queue)

runbooks.diagnosis: Redis answers on opensme-net as `redis` with requirepass (it is a netns passenger of postgres — nothing publishes it on host loopback). Invoice Ninja's REDIS_HOST used to live only in the .env baked into the image layer on first boot; every recreate loses it, Laravel falls back to 127.0.0.1:6379 and every session/cache/migration call is refused.
remediation: Declare REDIS_HOST: redis and REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDIS_PASSWORD} explicitly in BOTH the invoiceninja-fpm and invoiceninja-worker environment blocks (services/invoice-ninja.yml)
docker compose --profile invoice up -d --force-recreate invoiceninja-fpm invoiceninja-worker
Confirm the containers now resolve redis on opensme-net, not 127.0.0.1

runbooks.diagnosis: The lasuite/impress-backend image defaults CELERY_BROKER_URL to a passwordless broker URL on redis:6379/0 while this stack's redis requires AUTH. Worse, django-configurations reads env with prefix 'DJANGO', so a plain CELERY_BROKER_URL (no DJANGO_ prefix) is silently ignored and the celery task queue stays broken.
remediation: Set DJANGO_CELERY_BROKER_URL in the notes-backend environment (services/notes.yml): scheme 'redis', host redis, db /0, with the AUTH password interpolated from ${REDIS_PASSWORD} (never a literal secret)
Verify: POST /api/v1.0/documents/ returns 201 (was 500 with broker AuthenticationError)
